answer.label: Apocryphal Coolidge anecdote
answer.sourceLine: Quote Investigator traces the anecdote to Frank B. Noyes’s introduction at an Associated Press luncheon in 1924. It also records Coolidge’s immediate denial and provisionally labels the story apocryphal.
